name: gamepad-minecraft
title: Minecraft - Gamepad
summary: A controller-friendly Minecraft Java launcher for handhelds
description:
Play Minecraft Java Edition entirely with a gamepad - no keyboard or mouse required. Built for handheld gaming PCs like the Lenovo Legion Go S and MSI Claw, gamepad-minecraft lets you sign in once with your Microsoft account using a simple on-screen QR code, then play offline afterward with your saved profile. It also sets up your game so that Minecraft's own menus and title screen are fully navigable with a controller, not just the launcher itself.

Minecraft Java Edition itself is not included with this app - the first launch downloads it directly from Mojang, the same as the official launcher.
